response.sql: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), project_shares AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM project_counts) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM project_shares ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST, arcref LIMIT 10;
